summary: WriteFreely is a self-hosted blogging platform designed for minimalist publishing and federated networking. It allows you to run a clean, text-focused blog or an entire multi-user community connected to the wider fediverse. The software focuses on a distraction-free writing experience without the bloat of traditional content management systems.
goodFor: It is well-suited for individuals or small groups who want a lightweight, federated web presence without relying on mainstream social media or heavy publishing suites.
watchOut: The strict AGPL-3.0 licence may present compliance challenges if you plan to modify and distribute the code within a commercial environment. It also offers a very minimalist feature set, meaning advanced layouts and plugins require significantly more manual effort compared to established alternatives.
deployNotes: Written in Go, the application typically compiles into a single binary that requires a reverse proxy for TLS termination and a separate relational database like MySQL or PostgreSQL for data persistence.
